DevopsPipelineEnvironment.name: DevopsPipelineEnvironment
DevopsPipelineEnvironment.description: Represents the association between a DevopsPipeline and DevopsEnvironment objects. This object defines which orgs are part of the release pipeline.

DevopsEnvironmentId.description: The ID of the DevopsEnvironment record associated with the pipeline.

DevopsPipelineId.description: The ID of the parent DevopsPipeline record that this environment belongs to.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the environment is active for the specified pipeline.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: A unique, auto-generated name for the pipeline environment association record.
